title: A controller with a narrow middle, taught a rule's window in the closed loop
description: The first closed-loop stage of compact's controller: an encoder in net1's place maps each step's measurements to k latents, and a recurrent decoder in net2's place sets the window from the latents and its own previous decision alone (PPOSpec.latents). Nothing measured passes around the latents: the decoder's output is log2 of the window over a fixed 2^7 packets. Widths 4, 7, 10, 16 and 64 (64 stands for no constraint), seeds 1 to 3. This stage only gives each controller a sane start for reinforcement learning: DAgger, in which the controller acts in every rollout and each decision is labelled with the window of a fixed rule on the estimator of the seven hand-picked LCFs (2^0.25 times its believed bandwidth-delay product; experiments/estimator-seven.json). The start therefore leans toward what that rule reads, capacity and delay; the stage after it learns from the reward alone. k 0 is a reference without an encoder: the recurrent network on the measurements, its window on a measured bandwidth-delay product (maximum delivery rate over 2 s times minimum RTT). Training: 40 iterations of 32 links, 30 s episodes, the flow alone on 35% of the links and against competitors or copies of itself on 60%, exploration sigma 0.05, learning rate 0.001, 200 updates per iteration over the last 16 iterations' rollouts. Every 10 iterations the noise-free controller runs on the 21 validation links under 6 conditions and is scored by log utility, paired by link and condition with the fixed rule. Nothing is chosen from this run: every width goes on to the next stage, and the report says how far each start is from the rule. The test links are not read.
run: S="$OUT/spec-k$K-s$SEED.json"; jq --argjson k "$K" --argjson seed "$SEED" '.algo = "dagger" | .inputs = "raw" | (if $k > 0 then .latents = $k | .action_max = 8 else . end) | .share_k = 0 | .critic_warmup = 0 | .critic_flows = true | .lr = 0.001 | .updates_per_iteration = 200 | .replay_iterations = 16 | .tau_s = 1 | .noise_sigma = 0.05 | .group = 1 | .links_per_iteration = 32 | .copies = [2, 4] | .competition = "diverse" | .alone = 0.35 | .compete = 0.6 | .seed = $seed | .iterations = 40 | .eval_every = 10' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/ctl-k$K-s$SEED" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
